# Configure Microsoft Entra ID as the SCIM identity provider

This topic describes how to create a custom Microsoft Entra ID application and configure SCIM provisioning for HCP Terraform.

@include 'beta.mdx'

## Overview

Complete the following steps to configure Microsoft Entra ID for SCIM provisioning:

1. Create a custom application in Microsoft Entra ID with SAML SSO.
1. Enable SCIM in HCP Terraform and generate a SCIM token.
1. Configure provisioning in Microsoft Entra ID.
1. Assign users and groups.
1. Verify the configuration.

## Prerequisites

Before configuring SCIM provisioning with Microsoft Entra ID, verify the following:

- Your HCP Terraform organization is on a paid plan (Essentials, Standard, or Premium).
- You have a Microsoft Entra tenant with administrative access and permissions to configure enterprise application provisioning.
- You are using SAML SSO (not HCP SSO) for your HCP Terraform organization.
- You have reviewed [Set up SCIM provisioning](/terraform/cloud-docs/users-teams-organizations/scim/configure) and completed the preparation steps.

## Create a custom application in Entra ID

During the Beta, you cannot use the existing Terraform Cloud gallery application because it does not support enabling SCIM. You must create a custom application.

1. Sign in to the [Microsoft Entra admin center](https://entra.microsoft.com).
1. In the left navigation, select **Microsoft Entra ID**.
1. Navigate to **Enterprise Applications** and select **All Applications**.
1. Click **New application**, then click **Create your own application**.
1. Name the application. Use a descriptive name such as `Terraform Cloud – Beta`. You may also include additional information such as the environment or organization name.
1. Select **Integrate any other application you don't find in the gallery (Non-gallery)** and click **Create**.
1. On the application integration page, navigate to **Single sign-on** under the **Manage** section.
1. On the **Select a single sign-on method** page, select **SAML**.
1. In the **SAML Signing Certificate** section, copy the **App Federation Metadata URL**.
1. Follow the SSO configuration steps in [Configure single sign-on with Microsoft Entra ID for HCP Terraform](/terraform/cloud-docs/users-teams-organizations/single-sign-on/entra-id), starting at the HCP Terraform configuration section.
1. In Entra ID, edit **Attributes and Claims** in the Single sign-on settings and set:
   - **Unique User Identifier**: `user.userprincipalname`
1. In Entra ID attribute mapping, ensure the following mapping is present:

   | Source attribute | Target attribute | Mapping type | Matching precedence |
   |-----------------|-----------------|--------------|---------------------|
   | `userPrincipalName` | `username` | Direct | 1 |

<Note>

Entra ID processes provisioning changes on a recurring cycle that typically runs every 40 minutes. You can reduce this delay by initiating on-demand provisioning, either through the Entra ID UI or the Microsoft Graph API.

</Note>

## Enable SCIM in HCP Terraform

Enable SCIM provisioning in HCP Terraform to obtain the credentials for Entra ID configuration.

1. Log in to HCP Terraform and navigate to your organization.
1. Click **Organization settings** and then **SCIM provisioning**.
1. Click **Enable SCIM**.
1. Click **Generate SCIM token**.
1. Set an expiration date between 30 days and 1 year from the creation date.
1. Copy and save the SCIM token. Store it securely.
1. Copy and save the URL from the **Base URL** field.

## Configure provisioning in Microsoft Entra ID

1. Sign in to the [Microsoft Entra admin center](https://entra.microsoft.com).
1. Navigate to **Enterprise Applications** and select **All Applications**.
1. Open your custom HCP Terraform application.
1. Click **Provisioning** and select **Get started** or **New configuration**.
1. In the **Admin credentials** section:
   - **Tenant URL**: Enter the Base URL you copied from HCP Terraform.
   - **Secret token**: Enter the SCIM token you copied from HCP Terraform.
1. Click **Test Connection** to verify the configuration.
1. Click **Create** after the connection is verified.
1. Click **Start provisioning**.

## Assign users and groups

1. In your enterprise application, navigate to **Users and groups**.
1. Click **Add user/group**.
1. Select the users or groups to provision to HCP Terraform.
1. Click **Assign**.

### Plan your group assignments

When assigning groups:

- Groups assigned for SCIM team synchronization should be separate from the access group that controls SSO sign-in.
- IdP group names become team names in HCP Terraform. There is no mapping of group name to team name.
- Groups must have fewer than 1,000 members.

## Validate the configuration

After configuration, verify that provisioning works correctly.

### Verify user provisioning

1. Assign a test user in Entra ID.
1. Check that the user appears in HCP Terraform within 5 minutes. You can also use on-demand provisioning to trigger synchronization immediately.
1. Navigate to **Organization settings** > **Users** and verify the user status shows **Synced - Provisioned**.
1. Test that the user can log in using SSO.

### Verify group provisioning

1. Assign a test group in Entra ID.
1. Navigate to **Organization settings** > **Teams** and verify the group appears as a team.
1. Confirm team membership reflects the group membership in Entra ID.

## Troubleshooting

### Connection test fails

- Verify the **Tenant URL** is correct.
- Verify the SCIM token has not expired. Generate a new token in HCP Terraform if needed.

### Users not provisioned

- Verify the user is in scope for provisioning.
- Check the provisioning logs in Entra ID for errors related to the specific user.

### Duplicate users created

- Verify that the `mail` attribute in Entra ID matches the HCP Terraform account email exactly.
- Verify that `userPrincipalName` matches the SAML `nameID`. If your SAML SSO `nameID` uses `userPrincipalName` and it does not match `mail`, you may get duplicate users.
- Delete duplicate users and re-sync.

### Synchronization delay

Entra ID processes provisioning on a recurring cycle that typically runs every 40 minutes. To trigger synchronization immediately, use **on-demand provisioning** in the Entra ID UI or the Microsoft Graph API.

For additional troubleshooting, refer to [Troubleshoot SCIM provisioning](/terraform/cloud-docs/users-teams-organizations/scim/troubleshooting).
